seen.body:
## Behaviour
`qew project ensure` makes sure each board has the five columns in order, and repairs by editing in place: options qew does not own (for example a hand-made 'Parked' column) are KEPT after the canonical ones with their ids, colors and descriptions; a canonical option that exists with the wrong position is moved without changing its id (an id-dropping rewrite empties the column of its cards); an already-correct field is not rewritten at all (idempotent, zero writes); a legacy-named option that qew used to own is renamed in place (keeping id and cards) or dropped when its replacement already exists; a foreign option with a malformed shape fails loudly instead of being silently deleted. Forges without a repair path (GitLab labels, Forgejo) keep their typed Unsupported behaviour.

## Scenarios
- `ensure_keeps_custom_status_option`: a same-named project with a 'Parked' option survives ensure with its id; prevents blanking every card that uses it.
- `ensure_reorders_columns_keeping_option_ids`: a board whose 'Ready' sits last is reordered by one field update that carries the existing ids; prevents emptied columns.
- `ensure_on_a_correct_board_writes_nothing`: second run issues no field mutation; prevents churn and card resets.
- `ensure_adds_a_missing_column_to_an_older_board`: a board lacking 'Draft' gains it in place and reports the field as changed; prevents every later card write failing.
- `ensure_renames_or_drops_a_legacy_option`: legacy option becomes the new name keeping its id; dropped when the new one already exists; prevents a dead column forever.
- `malformed_foreign_option_fails_loudly`: an option without id/name is a typed error, not a silent drop; prevents data loss on garbage.

## Reference coverage
Tests: ensure keeps custom status option when repairing the field, moves the approval column behind Ready keeping ids, leaves a correct order alone, adds the Draft column to an older board, drops an emptied legacy column when the new one exists (5 tests plus the field-repair part of the first). Spec: projects.md paragraphs on option adoption, legacy option rename and foreign-option preservation.

## Qew today
Reduced. `forge_github.ensure_board` rewrites the whole Status field to exactly the five columns whenever the option names differ (`updateProjectV2Field` with only qew options), which deletes foreign options and loses their card values; the spec admits 'GitHub then drops the values of replaced options'. The idempotent no-rewrite case is covered by `test_ensure_is_idempotent_and_does_not_rewrite_matching_options`; `test_missing_status_field_is_created` covers a missing field. GitLab/Forgejo have no analogue.
seen.title: Repair a board's Status field without dropping foreign options or card values
